candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Target start availability: late August to early September 2026, subject to USCIS approval and EAD issuance

hero.label: Made for AlphaSense
hero.headline: I want to bring pipeline energy to AlphaSense's SDR frontline.
hero.subheadline: AlphaSense is turning market intelligence into a must-have layer for Fortune 1000 decision-makers and investment professionals, and that product sells itself to the right messenger. I have spent the last year doing exactly this work at an AI startup and a B2B consultancy, and I want to bring that rep experience to a company operating at this scale. The SDR role here is not a placeholder job for me, it is the exact next step I have been building toward.

whyCompany.title: AlphaSense sits where AI meets high-stakes financial decision-making
whyCompany.body: AlphaSense aggregates earnings calls, filings, broker research, and news into a single AI-powered search layer used by analysts and executives who cannot afford to miss signals. That is not a commodity product and it is not a hard story to believe in when you are cold calling. Selling something this substantive to sophisticated buyers is exactly the kind of SDR environment where I want to develop.

whyCompany.title: Tens of thousands of uncovered opportunities and a team that knows it
whyCompany.body: The job description does not pretend the pipeline is already built, it literally says tens of thousands of opportunities are waiting to be uncovered and trusts the SDR team to find them. That kind of honesty about scope tells me leadership is building something real and wants reps who treat prospecting as a craft. I thrive in that kind of environment because I have lived inside a startup where the pipeline was mine to create.

whyCompany.title: Cold outreach volume plus digital sequencing is exactly my background
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences, helping bring in 10 to 12 paying clients in just over a year. At NextAfter I sharpened my understanding of what makes B2B messaging convert across digital channels for sophisticated buyers. At AlphaSense those two things come together: multi-channel outreach to executives and investment professionals who require both relevance and precision in every touch.

quote: I have already done the scrappy version of this job at an AI startup with no brand name behind me. I want to bring that same hunger to a product and a market where the ceiling is actually high enough to match my ambition.
